study_purpose.text: The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of a new device for monitoring heart rhythm after an ablation procedure.

who_may_join.text: Patients with atrial fibrillation (AF) who have symptoms and are undergoing normal care.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will have the ILR device implanted and will undergo follow-up appointments. They may also be interviewed after hospital discharge.

risks_or_burdens.text: There is a small risk of distress during the interview and a time burden for patients and their carers.

time_commitment.text: not clearly stated in the retrieved evidence

what_is_unclear: Not clearly stated in the retrieved evidence

patient_facing_summary.text: This study involves patients with atrial fibrillation who may have the ILR device implanted and undergo follow-up appointments. They might also be interviewed after hospital discharge. Risks include slight distress and a time burden.
